authorization.request: 2026-11-22: 官网上面的精选插件、榜单里面的热门、收录、推荐、必装这几个板块，希望都放到插件雷达里面维护；插件可以调整顺序、手动加入 GitHub 项目地址、自动读取插件信息，并同步部署到官网。
authorization.scope: Add a committed curation file, build-time validation and artifacts, four-board plus homepage-featured rendering, and a plugin-side editor/publisher in dsh-plugin-scout. No Catalog, Profile, package, server, or credential change in this plan.

objective: Make the four public ranking boards and the homepage featured picks maintainable from the plugin radar without changing Catalog admission or install eligibility.

design.sourceOfTruth: registry/storefront-curation.json, committed and reviewed like any source file.
design.boards: Every board supports auto or an ordered manual allow-list. Recommended/essential keep the existing official-tool slots and minimum ordinary entries.
design.extras: Manual GitHub extras are bounded, normalized, GitHub-only and never appear on the listed board or as installable entries.
design.featured: home.featured is validated against approved Catalog entries and injected as a homepage meta list; legacy featured flags remain a fallback only when the file is absent.
design.publishPath: The plugin creates a plugin-scout/storefront-* branch, writes the single curation file as a GitHub-verified commit, opens a PR and enables squash auto-merge. The storefront-pr-automerge.yml workflow (added in #2028) re-validates the scope and file, and CodeQL gates the merge. A direct commit to main is rejected by the code-scanning ruleset.
design.failClosed: Malformed curation fails the build; stale ids are dropped per board; an empty manual board returns to auto; publish requires an explicit setting and typed confirmation.

deterministicGates: npm run check (syntax, registry validation, all node:test suites)
node scripts/build-marketplace-static.mjs in a disposable output directory
public readback of /rankings/curation.json and /rankings/choices.json after deploy
dsh-plugin-scout: npm run check (syntax plus its node:test suites)
excludedMutations: installed Profiles, packages or DSH runtime
production servers, systemd units, model settings or credentials

pagesEvidence.featuredMeta: home HTML contains dsh-featured-ids with the three curated picks
pagesEvidence.manualOrderSimulation: local build with the live snapshot and a manual popular board rendered the curated order plus a GitHub-only extra

officialDomains.reason: dsh.store and dsh-store.cn refresh from the Pages artifact on the three-hour timer; both returned 404 for the new curation artifacts before that refresh.
officialDomains.nextExpectedRefresh: 2026-11-22T15:47Z (plus up to five minutes of randomized delay)

deployment.notes: The plugin radar reads the Pages mirror when it is newer, so curation can continue before the official domains refresh. No Catalog, Profile, server or credential change was made by this plan.
